claimRule: Claim types: exact is decided from records held outside the application (a request-path observer that recorded the forbidden effect, or the response ScopeHaven received), and for a verdict decided by absence (an absence or count pass, or a fail because a required effect did not appear) only with every declared channel observed in its window by records held outside the application, nothing unaccounted on them, in a confined run; risk-bound is decided from records the application can write (or with no custody recorded), from a sampled property (a conversation judged over trials), or from a verdict decided by absence whose channels are undeclared, read from net change or watched only through the application's own records; descriptive decides nothing (inconclusive, error, not applicable, or a pass the gate does not count). A claim type says what a verdict rests on, not whether the record is accurate.

residual.note: The residual is what this run did not show: channels not observed or carrying an unaccounted effect, checks that read inconclusive and why, allowed-use pairing that did not hold, and declared observers that did not run or ran incomplete. Nothing listed here is a pass.
